learnings: Ad placement cap: this publication already holds a set of accepted ad opportunities each cycle (visible via list_ad_opportunities status=accepted). Placing fresh offers from list_ad_offers tries to ACCEPT new opportunities and fails with 'can not accept any more opportunities'. Fix: embed the already-accepted opportunity UUIDs (from list_ad_opportunities) as the advertisementOpportunity data-id, ranked by payout_per_click_cents, rather than offer ids from list_ad_offers.
